confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate, not checked against live listings or menus. Restaurant and cafe anchors are more reliable than July accommodation, which is volatile and set for July rather than the August Festival peak. Room rates are before any Edinburgh visitor levy that may apply from 2026. Beer is taken as roughly a pint-sized draught. Cocktail and wine are set relative to the local beer price because direct knowledge is weak. Pound-based figures use an assumed rate of about 1.33 USD per GBP, not live-checked. The 15 Oct FX value appeared only in the RBA table in search results and was not confirmed on the live page; the 14 Oct figure in that table was 0.7002.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. Anchors reflect Edinburgh's own UK price levels from general knowledge, set for a July high-season window, with rough reference to other large UK visitor cities.
